## Objetivo
Implement poll creation with a title and multiple UTC date/time slots, yes/maybe/no voting, deterministic best slot, explicit night confirmation and attendee snapshots. Deliver the responsive poll detail screen and focused feature tests. Shared server SSE transport/publication belongs to T13; client invalidation/refetch and live browser coverage belong to T15, not this task.

## Critérios de Aceitação
- [ ] Unit tests prove ordering by yes, maybe, UTC slot time and ID, including no-vote and exact ties. HTTP tests cover slot validation, own-vote upsert, missing-vote distinction, no impersonation, all response values and unauthorized access. Extend T08's private-route authorization matrix for polls and confirmed nights. Dates display with an explicit local time-zone label.
- [ ] Confirmation requires an existing slot and positive integer duration and snapshots its yes voters; votes changed later leave the snapshot unchanged until explicit reconfirmation. Integration tests verify this rule, zero-attendee behavior and invalid slots/durations. Reopening the same explicitly injected temporary database retains polls, votes and confirmed-night attendees; tests never access the development database.
- [ ] Poll UI creates slots, displays member response labels and counts, highlights exactly one best slot and supports confirmation with duration. The initiating client refetches canonical poll/night data after successful mutations. Browser tests at 1280x720 and 390x844 vote, confirm a night and capture viewport-only voted/confirmed states with the relevant controls scrolled into view. Reuse T01 diagnostics, condition-based waits and isolated browser data. Poll errors/empty states are styled and controls are touch-sized. Cross-session server delivery is tested in T13; live browser updates in T15.
- [ ] npm test, npm run typecheck and npm run build pass. Feature browser tests run with npm run test:e2e through run_browser_tests; no SSE implementation is required for this task's acceptance.
